Third-party code used by the ticket pages

qrcode.js   QR Code Generator for JavaScript, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license
            https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
jsQR.js     jsQR, Cosmo Wolfe, Apache License 2.0
            https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
aos.js      AOS (Animate On Scroll) 2.3.4, Michał Sajnóg, MIT license
aos.css     https://github.com/michalsnik/aos
animate.min.css  Animate.css 4.1.1, Daniel Eden, MIT license
            https://github.com/animate-css/animate.css
            (self-hosted so these pages no longer load code from a third-party CDN)
